svg.title: 3C orchestration: skill chain from programme-manager to developer
svg.desc: Diagram A. Names every role in the governed workflow: programme-manager (cross-project), project-manager (per-CWD), expert advisors, developer, e2e-writer, tester, sprint-close, retrospective. Solid arrows show dispatch; dotted arrows show the retrospective-to-rule feedback loop.
